messages.沈潜で敵の精神力をじわじわ削るシンプルな人格。出撃しないときも、サポートパッシブ: A straightforward Identity that wears down enemy SP with Sinking. When not deployed, his support passive, Information Neutralization, can help the ally with the lowest SP.
messages.沈潜付与: S1「弾く」・S2「突き刺す」・S3「連撃」で沈潜を付与。S2はⅡコ: **Inflicting Sinking**: S1 Deflect, S2 End-stop Stab, and S3 Enjamb inflict Sinking. On hit, Coin Ⅱ of S2 also increases Sinking Count by 1.
messages.サポートパッシブ「情報中和」(憂鬱×4・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も低: **Support passive — Information Neutralization (4 Gloom Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: If the 1 ally with the lowest SP lost SP during the turn, that ally recovers 10 SP at Turn End. This applies while Yi Sang is in the team but not participating in battle.
messages.脆弱付与: S3のⅢコイン的中時、対象の精神力が0未満なら次のターンに脆弱1を付: **Inflicting Fragile**: On hit, Coin Ⅲ of S3 inflicts 1 Fragile next turn if the target's SP is below 0.
messages.バトルパッシブ「情報伝達」(憂鬱×4・共鳴): 操作パネルで自分より後ろの味方2: **Combat passive — Information Relay (4 Gloom Resonance)**: Gives 1 Damage Up to the 2 allies behind him on the dashboard.
messages.出撃時はS1・S2で沈潜を重ねて敵の精神力を削る。S3の脆弱は対象の精神力が0未: When deployed, build Sinking with S1 and S2 to drain enemy SP. S3 only inflicts Fragile when the target is below 0 SP, so this effect rarely activates outside a Sinking team. Information Relay requires 4 Gloom Resonance; aim for it in a team with enough Gloom skills.
messages.出撃させないときは控えに置き、「情報中和」で精神力を消耗する味方の回復役として使: When he is not deployed, use Information Neutralization to support allies who spend SP. It only targets the 1 ally with the lowest SP and only activates on a turn when that ally loses SP.
